app_fee.value: No application fee is stated on the Collège doctoral admission or CD3 foreign-diploma validation pages; the €398 doctoral registration fee (plus €105 CVEC) is paid online only after Doctoral School admission is confirmed.

also.quote: Once your admission to the Doctoral School has been confirmed, you will receive an e-mail from the "scolarité" Office with a link to your registration form (including payment of your registration fees).
The registration fee is €398 for all PhD registrations for the academic year 2026/2027.

fee_waiver.value: No application-fee waiver is stated; the Collège doctoral fee-exemption scheme (French government scholarship, cotutelle, disability/refugee status, or financial hardship) applies to the €398 post-admission registration fee.

gre_general.value: No university-wide GRE requirement is stated on the Collège doctoral pages; each of UGA's 13 doctoral schools sets its own admission prerequisites.

toefl_min.value: No university-wide TOEFL minimum is stated on the Collège doctoral pages checked.

ielts_min.value: No university-wide IELTS minimum is stated on the Collège doctoral pages checked.

english_waiver.value: No university-wide English-test or Indian-degree exemption rule is stated on the Collège doctoral pages checked.

notes: Pedagogical admission is handled by each of UGA's 13 doctoral schools (with foreign non-French Master's degrees examined monthly by the Commission Dispenses et Dérogations Doctorales, CD3), after which the Collège doctoral handles administrative registration (€398 + €105 CVEC for 2026/27). Checked English and French Collège doctoral application/admission, first-year registration, registration-at-doctoral-college, tuition-fee-exemption, and CD3 foreign-diploma exemption pages.
